items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: I was invited by Diana Krall, who was involved in producing this album with Paul. ... So she and Paul and her rhythm section had already put down the tracks. ... I know exactly when he meant is that what they need is not something which would be inappropriate, to suddenly soar over the strings

ctx.x: New Zealand native Alan Broadbent has distinguished himself as a jazz pianist, arranger, and composer. He has collaborated with a diverse list of artists, from Charlie Haden to Paul McCartney, and he is frequently called upon for his distinctive string arrangements.
Alan was interviewed via Zoom on October 26, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
